items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: He was the originator of the bolo punch that Kid Gavilan used to throw all the time.

ctx.x: He was a great pugilist. He was the one that Henry Armstrong took the title away from. He was the originator of the bolo punch that Kid Gavilan used to throw all the time. But he was a tough customer. And there would be fighting. So when they'd start fighting, we'd just go back in the empty
